Remove the coop binary and (optionally) its data directories

Usage: coop uninstall [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -y, --yes        Skip interactive confirmation prompts (removes data unless --keep-data)
      --keep-data  Remove only the binary, keep ~/.coop and update-check state
      --purge      Also remove data without prompting (pairs with --yes for CI)
  -h, --help       Print help
